say:2:1631806001:1.text: I don't think so... I mean, what kind of headmaster turns into a ghost just to scare his own students?!
say:2:1631806001:1.source_cn: 不会吧……哪儿有校长变成幽灵后吓唬学生的啊！

say:3:1631806002:1.text: Then again, if it were Leymar, I guess I can't totally rule it out!
say:3:1631806002:1.source_cn: 但如果是雷蒙校长的话，好像不是不可能！

say:4:1631806003:1.text: Yeah, he's totally the kind of guy who'd haunt people for fun.
say:4:1631806003:1.source_cn: 你说得对，如果是雷蒙那家伙，哪怕变成幽灵也会到处吓人。

say:5:1631806004:1.text: But you don't need to freak out so much. If he knew you were scared of ghosts, he'd probably leave you alone.
say:5:1631806004:1.source_cn: 不过你也不用太担心，雷蒙知道你害怕幽灵的话，就不会来找你。

say:6:1631806005:1.text: Besides, it's not like just anyone can become a ghost.
say:6:1631806005:1.source_cn: 更何况，不是谁都能变成幽灵的。

say:7:1631806006:1.text: Okay, but seriously, do you really see Headmaster Leymar turning into one?
say:7:1631806006:1.source_cn: 老师，那你觉得雷蒙校长会变成幽灵么？

choice_prompt:8:1631806006.text: Okay, but seriously, do you really see Headmaster Leymar turning into one?
choice_prompt:8:1631806006.source_cn: 老师，那你觉得雷蒙校长会变成幽灵么？

say:9:1631806007:1.text: He spent his whole life working himself to the bone for this school. He deserves a good rest.
say:9:1631806007:1.source_cn: 他为学校操劳了一辈子，更应该好好休息。
say:9:1631806007:1.male: He spent his whole life working himself to the bone for this school. He deserves a good rest.
say:9:1631806007:1.female: He spent his whole life working himself to the bone for this school. He deserves a good rest.

say:10:1631806008:1.text: Still, it'd be nice to see him again...
say:10:1631806008:1.source_cn: 但还是很想再见他一面啊……
